assurance: Internal written uniform strategy obstruction, exact equivariance and constructive escape. No unrestricted orbit distinction or arbitrary-tree extraction theorem.

declarations.name: Lemma1. Deletion commutes with every leaf-preserving elementary move
declarations.scope: All positive/inverse moves and both local factor orders; the current attachment anchor is recomputed, and the lower subgroup is literally invariant on the remaining sheet labels.

declarations.name: Theorem2. An imprimitive deletion blocks this strategy
declarations.scope: An imprimitive lower group prevents the chosen leaf's color from gaining a second exclusive leaf along paths retaining the chosen sheet as a leaf at every elementary stage.

declarations.name: Theorem3. Full-alternating counterfamilies in every degree
declarations.scope: For every r>=3 the path family has full A_(2r+1), no initially removable DT, and exact lower C2 wr S_r after deleting its selected leaf.

declarations.name: Proposition4. A leaf-handoff braid escapes the restriction
declarations.scope: A generic clean-overlap Q^-2 identity hands the leaf between colors through an intermediate nonleaf stage. The path family has an explicit length-r escape extracting two leaves; its lower group becomes S_(2r).
